app.name: FantasticFrame
app.emptyDesc: Upload photos to begin creating your fantastic frames.

privacyModal.title: Privacy Notice
privacyModal.p1: Your photos are processed entirely in your browser. Single and batch exports are rendered locally via WASM and never leave your device.
privacyModal.p2: Only if your browser cannot render a photo does that one photo go to our server as a fallback. It is kept in server memory for the duration of the request, never written to disk or a database, and discarded right after.
privacyModal.p3: No accounts, cookies, ads or tracking, and your browser makes no third-party requests: fonts are self-hosted. Your theme and language are saved in your browser only. Server location: Germany, EU (GDPR).
privacyModal.p4: Only when you use the Location field on a photo with GPS data is its position, rounded to about 1 km, sent through our server to OpenStreetMap Nominatim to find the city name. Your IP address and the photo are not passed on.
